item.title: New school bus cameras will nab drivers running stop signs | Jacksonville Today
item.description: Cameras on all Duval County school buses will record drivers who pass illegally. Violators will be fined $225.

item.title: Bring patience and sunscreen: It’s fair time in Clay County | Jacksonville Today
item.description: An estimated 100,000 people are possible at the 40th Clay County Agricultural Fair. Traffic could be a challenge.

item.title: Low pressure: Some JEA customers could feel the drought — literally | Jacksonville Today
item.description: Utility officials are warning customers about possible intermittent water pressure as the drought pushes demand.

item.title: Jaguars will play home games in Orlando in 2027 | Jacksonville Today
item.description: NFL owners agreed for the Jaguars to play at Camping World Stadium while EverBank Stadium is renovated.

item.title: Countdown is on for Artemis II launch to the moon | Jacksonville Today
item.description: A two-hour launch window will open at 6:24 p.m. Wednesday for the manned Artemis II mission.

item.title: THE JAXSON | The woman behind the Richmond Hotel: the Alice Kirkpatrick story | Jacksonville Today
item.description: Alice Kirkpatrick was a Jacksonville businesswoman at the center of Black enterprise, civic life and cultural exchange during the Jim Crow era.

item.title: Some Duval students spend time learning outdoors | Jacksonville Today
item.description: Three schools are part of a pilot program to balance computer-heavy days with outdoors lessons.

item.title: Activists fight for cat colonies in St. Johns County | Jacksonville Today
item.description: Activists want the county to create a policy to neuter or spay unowned cats and return them to their surroundings.

item.title: Matthew Gilbert Middle dedicates track to Bob Hayes | Jacksonville Today
item.description: The track and field at Matthew Gilbert Middle School was renamed Tuesday afternoon in honor of the one Panther whom no one could catch – Robert “Bullet Bob” Hayes.

item.title: Duval included in challenge to new Florida voting law | Jacksonville Today
item.description: The ACLU is suing the state over a law requiring proof of citizenship to cast a ballot.
